summary: The agent failed because it rounded all output values to 2 decimal places (f'{val:.2f}'), directly violating the critical no-rounding rule already documented in clinical-lab-harmonization. The agent also did not consult the existing skill despite it covering all required conversions (Bilirubin ÷17.1, Albumin ÷10, Phosphorus ×3.097) and multi-file join patterns. This update strengthens the no-rounding directive with a prominent early-warning block, adds a multi-file join workflow with column ordering guidance, and includes a transplant/hepatic panel quick-reference to make the skill more discoverable for this task pattern.
